translations.web: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.
translations.bsb: You know that when you were pagans, you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.
translations.kjv: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
translations.asv: Ye know that when ye were Gentiles ye were led away unto those dumb idols, howsoever ye might led.
